d: Elaine (Samantha Robinson), a beautiful young witch, is determined to find a man to love her. In her gothic Victorian apartment she makes spells and potions, then picks up men and seduces them. However, her spells work too well, and she ends up with a string of hapless victims. When she at last meets the man of her dreams, her desperation to be loved drives her to the brink of insanity and murder.
A boy makes friends with Trumpy, a furry creature from afar with webbed fingers and a long snout.
Fraternity and sorority pledges ignore rumors and spend the night in a mansion haunted by victims of a family massacre.
Small-town vigilantes led by the mailman (Charles Durning) do not get away with killing a local simpleton.
The younger sibling of the teenager who killed while dressed as Santa carries on in his brother's bloody footsteps.
